content:
Your reputation is being built... even when nobody is watching.

Every email you send.

Every deadline you meet.

Every promise you keep.

Every conversation you have.

People are quietly deciding one thing:

"Can I trust this person?"

Authority isn't created by a job title.

It isn't created by followers.

It isn't created by expensive clothes.

It's created when people know that your words and your actions match.

That's why I believe your reputation is your biggest professional asset.

It takes years to build.

One moment to lose.

Protect it.
